Contact: (817) 585-6388 | joshua.dfwpristine@gmail.com
Hours: open 24 hours
Owner: Josh Collins

## What distinguishes this business

Surfaces are matched to a cleaning method rather than everything receiving the
same pressure. Concrete is cleaned with rotary surface cleaners at working
pressure. Siding, stucco, roofs and natural stone are soft washed - detergent,
dwell time and a low-pressure rinse - because high pressure permanently damages
them. No acidic cleaners are used on limestone or other calcium-carbonate stone.

## Delicate stone specialisms

Soft, porous or acid-sensitive natural stone, each with its own page:

- Limestone: /services/delicate-stone-cleaning/limestone
- Austin Stone (cream Texas limestone veneer): /services/delicate-stone-cleaning/austin-stone
- Flagstone (usually Oklahoma sandstone): /services/delicate-stone-cleaning/flagstone
- Pennsylvania Stone / bluestone: /services/delicate-stone-cleaning/pennsylvania-stone
- Lueders Stone (also spelled Leuders): /services/delicate-stone-cleaning/lueders-stone

## Commercial

Parking lots and drive lanes, loading docks and aprons, dumpster pads, fuel
islands and canopies, storefronts and sidewalks, and fleet washing. Usually
scheduled overnight. Certificates of insurance available on request.
/services/commercial-pressure-washing
